finding: src/anomaly/_signal_projection.py:171 Valid repeated detector runs make the projection permanently unbuildable.
rationale: A normal second execute_detectors call is reachable with the same persistent Gate A receipt and unchanged prepared table: it creates a new timestamped run_id but recomputes the same signal_id from detector_id, table_id, and candidate_id, then appends that row. Search subsequently rejects the changed JSONL as stale, while rebuild rejects the repeated signal_id before projection construction; the locked tests cover only distinct signal IDs across runs, so no upstream guard, fail-safe deduplication, or repeated-run contract makes the blocker unreachable or less than high severity.

evidence.output: 524-580: _require_gate_a reads and validates the persistent plan/receipt and returns scopes; it does not consume or invalidate approval. 583-590: execute_detectors is a public phase entry point accepting caller-supplied now. 653-675: candidate_id comes from the deterministic query result and signal_id is sha256(detector_id:table_id:candidate_id), with no run component. 678-684: run_id includes the timestamp and is assigned only after signal_id. 738-740: every produced row is appended to evidence/signals.jsonl.

The real detector selects candidate_id as 'row-' || id from an unchanged prepared table and orders no mutable input into that identity, so the same qualifying row is emitted with the same candidate_id on a rerun.

133-138: verified_projection raises StaleSignalProjectionError when evidence/signals.jsonl changes. 167-182: rebuild reads every JSONL row and validates each through one shared seen set. 249-272: _validate_signal raises SignalSearchError on the second occurrence of a signal_id. 224-245: each projected row carries one run_id but signal_ref is only {path: evidence/signals.jsonl, signal_id}; 362-377 makes signal_id the DuckDB primary key.

29-105 seeds three globally unique signal IDs; its two run IDs never repeat the same signal identity. 213-257 exercises run filtering and asserts signal_ref only as {path, signal_id}. 292-308 checks pagination duplicates, not a detector rerun or duplicate canonical signal identity. No supplied task-29 test covers the reachable repeated-run case.
